sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR: Qwen3-ASR is an open-source series of ASR ...
sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects. Both leverage large-scale speech training data and the strong audio understanding capability of their foundation model, Qwen3-Omni.

sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑0.6B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual language model with 0.6 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.
